title: Outcome
description: Labeled trading outcome for one signal.

entryTs.description: See common $defs/Timestamp. Inlined so the generated Go field is time.Time.

exitTs.description: See common $defs/Timestamp. Inlined so the generated Go field is time.Time.

feeBps.description: One-way fee in basis points. netReturn subtracts the round trip fee, 2 * feeBps / 10000.

grossReturn.description: Signed return from the entry bar open to the exit bar close, before fees.

netReturn.description: Signed return from the entry bar open to the exit bar close, minus the round-trip fee.

candlesHash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of exactly the used bars. Decimal fields are normalized to 12 decimal places; timestamps are UTC RFC3339Nano.

labeledAt.description: See common $defs/Timestamp. Inlined so the generated Go field is time.Time.
